trap-superlative.evidence: "Max rel. err. across all 4 atoms: ~10^{-15} -- **exact at f64 precision**." Reinforced by "equals the Markov parameter z exactly" in the title and "factor z exactly" / "factor z - h exactly" in the structural reading.
